scientific_integrity: Analytic eigenspace-rank proof plus a standalone finite verifier. Unchecked external literature and exact scope are disclosed; no novelty certification or external endorsement is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two independent ring controls, uniform unit rim weights and uniform positive spoke weight; no claim on heterogeneous wheels, hub actuators, time-varying networks or control energy. Full text of the later Liu–Ji cycle-generated-graph study could not be compared. Independent validation not performed.
title: Exact two-leader controllability ranks and spoke resonances on weighted wheels
